holding.payout_warn_note: Owner review 2026-10-23: a payout above ~90% of profit is flagged "High payout, may not last"; above dividends.suspect_payout_pct it is suspect.

undervalued.sector_note: Sector P/E = median of peers with a trusted P/E; skipped when fewer than sector_min_peers or when the interquartile range is wider than sector_max_iqr_ratio x the median (sector too mixed to compare).

valuation.eps_max_age_note: A filing EPS basis (consolidated, unconsolidated, not stated) whose newest full-year figure ends more than this many months ago is skipped for the next basis, then PSX's screener P/E. 15 = a year plus a margin while the next results are published (owner review 2026-10-23).

dividends.settlement_note: T+1 since 2026-02-09: shares must settle before book closure starts, so the last day to buy is 2 working days before it. Confirm once with the broker.

ai.eps_backfill_note: Old results filings (latest annual + up to 3 quarters) read per night for held and watched stocks with no stored EPS.
ai.results_fact_days_note: A results filing older than this no longer counts as a company's latest results in the AI facts.

data.ticks_keep_days_note: Intraday portfolio values kept for Home's 1D chart.

costs.source: PSX notice N-1026 (brokerage minimum, trading fee, SECP levy), researched 2026-10-15. Every rate is a setting; VERIFY against a JS InvestPro contract note.

tax.source: Section 37A (CGT, collected monthly by NCCPL, FIFO, netted across stocks per tax year 1 Jul-30 Jun) and Section 150 (dividend WHT), researched 2026-10-15. VERIFY the non-filer CGT rate from 1 Jul 2026 and the WHT rate for power companies.

cgt.note: slab index = full years held (0 = under a year); non-filer slab not confirmed, VERIFY
non-filer may have doubled from 1 Jul 2026: VERIFY on nccpl.com.pk/cgt

power.note: per company, VERIFY on a dividend credit advice

psx_holidays.source: Fixed national holidays only. Eid, Ashura and other lunar holidays must be added when PSX announces them; days with a KSE-100 close in index_daily count as traded regardless.

bluechip.source: Blue-chip (BC) badge, owner spec 2026-10-16. Every threshold lives here; the code holds no ticker list.
bluechip.liquidity_basis: PSX screener 30-day average volume x price (PSX publishes no 60-day daily series on a page we read honestly)
bluechip.profit_years_note: 4 = what PSX Financials shows (owner chose 2026-10-16); set 5 for the strict rule once a 5th year is stored
bluechip.dividend_mode_note: 'available': PSX trailing yield > 0 and no gap in the years covered by filings read so far; 'strict': a dividend in dividend_years_needed of dividend_years_window years, from filings only
bluechip.audit_note: false: a qualified opinion still fails once an annual report is read; a missing report does not block the badge

regime.source: Bull market ON/OFF, owner request 2026-10-18. Trend from KSE-100 closes the worker stores and PSX's screener (market cap, 1-year change, P/E of the index stocks); interest rate from the State Bank of Pakistan. Every threshold is here.
regime.rule_note: ON when the KSE-100 is up 20% on a year (PSX's 1-year change of the index stocks, weighted by market cap) or 20% above its 12-month low, and not below its 200-day average. OFF after a 20% fall from the 12-month high, or below the average with the 1-year change negative. Until 120 days of closes are stored the average is skipped.
regime.rates_note: VERIFY: estimates from the policy rate. Savings: SBP's minimum profit on rupee savings deposits is 0.5% below its repo (floor) rate, which is 1% below the policy rate (BPRD Circular 07 of 2013, https://www.sbp.org.pk/bprd/2013/c7.htm; reported narrowed to individuals up to Rs 10 million from 1 Aug 2026, not checked against SBP). Money-market funds track T-bills, before fees and tax. Check your bank's and the fund's published rates.

compass.source: Market Compass, owner go-ahead 2026-10-18. Three separate lights (value, shares vs safe yield, trend) plus rates and inflation; only extra money changes, the monthly SIP never does. Research: Al Meezan Rapid Reads Jul 2026, AHL Pakistan Strategy, BMA Capital Jan 2021, Faber 10-month trend, Vanguard/Morningstar on staying invested.
compass.pe_avg_note: VERIFY: Al Meezan (Jul 2026) puts the KSE-100's 20-year average forward P/E at about 8.5x (AHL 10-year 8.0x; MG since 2005 9.3x). Ours is the trailing P/E of the index stocks from PSX's screener, so it can differ by a turn or so.
compass.pe_bands_note: Below ~6x has been a buying zone (2019, 2023, 2024); above ~10-11x marked the 2008 and 2017 tops (Al Meezan, AHL). Thresholds are settings.
compass.spread_note: Owner decision 2026-10-23: earnings yield of the KSE-100 stocks minus the money-market estimate (3-month T-bill minus money_market_fee_pct), the place the cash advice sends money. Between spread_neutral_low and spread_neutral_high (inclusive) nothing changes; below the low end the advice is to park extra cash. VERIFY: spread_shares_above was 3.5 against the 10-year PIB (BMA Capital Jan 2021, ~+1.8 average over 10 years); the money-market estimate sits ~1.5-2 points below the PIB, so 2 is a re-based guess. The 10-year PIB is still shown for information.
compass.money_market_note: VERIFY: money-market funds hold T-bills; estimate = 3-month T-bill cut-off minus about 1% for fees, before tax. MUFAP's fund returns are behind a bot check, so they are not read.
compass.mix_note: Split for spare cash beyond your monthly investment and crash fund. A rule of thumb, not advice.

performance.benchmark_note: The comparison with the KSE-100 is hidden until this many calendar days of portfolio history are stored (owner review: a few days tell you nothing).

growth.inflation_note: VERIFY: default inflation for the today-money projection; Pakistan CPI was ~10% (Sep 2026, PBS). A setting in Profile.

symbols.aliases_note: Common long forms mapped to PSX symbols (PSX lists Oil & Gas Development Company as OGDC).
